name: LEGAR_BENCH
description:
# LEGAR BENCH LEGAR BENCH is the first large-scale Korean legal case retrieval benchmark, comprising two dataset versions tailored to different evaluation needs: ### 1. LEGAR BENCH_standard This is designed for a comprehensive evaluation across a broad spectrum of criminal offenses. The queries cover 411 distinct crime types across 33 criminal categories and are evaluated over a retrieval pool of 1.2M cases. Below are 411 crime types grouped under 33 categories.

reputation: A large-scale, recently released benchmark for Korean legal case retrieval; gaining attention in Korean legal NLP research but not yet widely adopted globally.
